blogs.title: Harvesting Math from the Web: How DeepSeekMath Built a 120‑Billion‑Token Corpus
blogs.description: A behind‑the‑scenes look at the data pipeline that turned raw Common Crawl pages into the high‑quality, multilingual DeepSeekMath Corpus. We’ll explain the fastText classifier, iterative domain harvesting, de‑duplication, and benchmark de‑contamination steps, and why public web data can beat curated arXiv collections for mathematical reasoning.

blogs.title: From Code to Calculus: Why Starting with a Coding Model Improves Math Reasoning
blogs.description: An accessible explanation of the authors’ experiments showing that pre‑training on code before math gives a measurable boost in both tool‑free and program‑aided problem solving. We’ll break down the two‑stage vs. one‑stage training setups, the concept of catastrophic forgetting, and what this means for future model design.

blogs.title: Teaching LLMs to Think Step‑by‑Step: Instruction Tuning and Chain‑of‑Thought for Math
blogs.description: A walkthrough of how DeepSeekMath‑Instruct was built using chain‑of‑thought, program‑of‑thought, and tool‑integrated reasoning data in English and Chinese. The post will illustrate how few hundred thousand curated examples can lift a 7B model to compete with 70B peers on benchmarks like MATH and GSM8K.

blogs.title: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO): A Memory‑Efficient Boost for Math LLMs
blogs.description: Demystifies the new reinforcement learning algorithm introduced in the paper. We’ll compare GRPO to traditional PPO, explain the clever “group baseline” trick that removes the need for a critic model, and show how it boosts performance while cutting GPU memory use.

blogs.title: Why Bigger Isn’t Always Better: DeepSeekMath 7B Beats a 540B Closed Model
blogs.description: Analyzes the surprising result that a 7B open‑source model outperforms Minerva’s 540B version on competition‑level math benchmarks. The article will discuss data quality vs. scale, multilingual training benefits, and what this implies for the open‑source AI community.

blogs.title: Beyond Numbers: Evaluating DeepSeekMath on Formal Proofs and Multilingual Benchmarks
blogs.description: Explores how the model performs on formal theorem proving (miniF2F with Isabelle) and Chinese math tasks like CMATH and Gaokao benchmarks. The post will explain why multilingual pre‑training matters and how it opens doors for AI assistance in non‑English education.
